 "data": "flowchart TB
 subgraph PREP[\"1. Prepare the knowledge\"]
 DATA[\"Historical tickets and knowledge articles\"]
 CLEAN[\"Clean and validate data\"]
 EMBED[\"Create chunks and local embeddings\"]
 STORE[(\"PostgreSQL + pgvector\")]

 DATA --> CLEAN --> EMBED --> STORE
 end

 subgraph SEARCH[\"2. Understand and find evidence\"]
 USER[\"Support agent enters a complaint\"]
 ANALYZE[\"Understand the issue<br/>Intent, product, severity and sentiment\"]
 RETRIEVE[\"Hybrid search<br/>BM25 + semantic search\"]
 RANK[\"Combine rankings and rerank<br/>Select relevant evidence\"]

 USER --> ANALYZE --> RETRIEVE --> RANK
 STORE --> RETRIEVE
 end

 subgraph ANSWER[\"3. Recommend the next action\"]
 DRAFT[\"Draft resolution steps<br/>Using evidence and citations\"]
 CHECK{\"Enough supporting evidence?\"}
 RESULT[\"Show cited steps<br/>For agent review\"]
 HELP[\"Ask for clarification<br/>or escalate to a human\"]

 RANK --> DRAFT --> CHECK
 CHECK -->|Yes| RESULT
 CHECK -->|No| HELP
 end

 EVAL[\"Evaluate quality and monitor performance\"]
 SEARCH -.-> EVAL
 ANSWER -.-> EVAL",
 "config": null
